title: Box queue status sidecar can disappear during a queued build
body: A queued VIXEN build emitted '/home/liory/Github/box-queue/compat/../queue/with-test-lock.sh: line 4026: /tmp/undertow-box-flow-3871983.status: No such file or directory' while the live queue was admitting cx-tu02:family-seams-build. The job continued, but queue status bookkeeping should create or retain its sidecar atomically so admitted lanes do not lose diagnostics. Consolidate the queue status-file lifecycle and make the wrapper failure-free.

title: Box queue diagnostic breaker reuses a fixed compile error after the source is repaired
body: After fixing the reported compiler error in BuildLightingShadow.cpp, the next identical queued cmake/build command was refused as DIAGNOSTIC_REUSED (diagnostic_id ccabf7042eeec717) and required UT_QUEUE_BREAKER=0 to force a fresh run. The queue should invalidate keyed compiler diagnostics when the worktree input fingerprint changes, or expose a lane-safe automatic retry after a source fix.

title: Queued light payloads do not reliably inherit the build worktree directory
body: The queued preprocessed-size witness ran from a directory without build.ninja, so 'ninja -t commands VixenApp' failed until the payload was changed to use an explicit 'ninja -C build-tu02'. Heavy configure/build payloads happened to work with explicit -S/-B paths, but diagnostic/trace commands should receive a documented worktree cwd or expose the queue cwd so lane scripts do not guess.
